cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before I open the scholarship letter, do we have clean teaspoons? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made your tea. Open it; I want to know if you're leaving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You've put sugar in mine. I'll need another cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Take mine. Are you frightened of going, or staying here with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If we swap cups, how will you know which has sugar? We need labels before anything gets mixed up.

mechanism: A directs tea preparation and accepts revised cup arrangements to keep B occupied with practical details rather than the fear attached to a scholarship letter.
confusable: Unlike useful preparation alone, A extends logistics after B offers a solution and names emotional stakes; cooperation changes the form of avoidance.
comparison: An unopened opportunity creates uncertainty about a shared future, unlike an already planned move with a departing train.
seedUse: D110-a scholarship letter, sugar and cup swap; S02-a accommodates the partner method while retaining a procedural agenda.
